## What's new

- **Buckets in the `kamplexfs` backend.** rclone makes a bucket when a
  directory, file or server-side copy needs one and removes it with
  `rmdir` or `purge` once it is empty, using the server's
  `/api/v1/buckets` endpoints. Listing `remote:` lists the buckets with
  them too. Servers without these endpoints work as before: their
  buckets must already exist and are left in place.
- **`--fast-list` on direct-fs servers.** Recursive listings which are
  marked `"recursive": true` include every folder, so the `kamplexfs`
  backend now uses them on direct-fs servers too, keeping empty
  directories. With servers which don't mark them it still lists
  directory by directory unless the server is in packed-volume mode.
- **`rclone selfupdate` protection.** `selfupdate` installs official
  rclone, which would replace this build and remove the KamPlexFS
  support, so it now refuses with a warning unless given
  `--force-upstream-update`. `rclone selfupdate --check` still works
  and says that the versions it reports are upstream releases.

## Fixes

- Moving a whole bucket with a server-side directory move now removes
  the emptied source bucket, in both the `kamplexfs` backend and the
  s3 backend with `provider = KamPlexFS`.
